cases.query: What backend jobs are running right now, and has anything been running an unusually long time?
An NQE query on network 4610 has been running for 45 minutes and never returns. Is it actually stuck?
expected_behavior: flags the job likely_stuck once it has run past the threshold (default 20 minutes)

cases.query: Why did yesterday's snapshot processing on network 4610 end up TIMEDOUT?
expected_behavior: finds the row with state TIMEDOUT and reads its longest_running_time_seconds

cases.query: Is collection running on this network right now?
Is CPU or memory unhealthy on any Forward component right now?
